1\. Redirect restores source context 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
During follow_redirects=True, Werkzeug recursively calls FlaskClient.open, so the pending list
contains the source context followed by the destination context. Replaying with pop() enters the
destination first and source last, leaving request bound to the redirect source instead of the
final response.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Preserved contexts are appended in request order, but replaying them with `list.pop()` reverses that order. For a followed redirect, the source context becomes active instead of the final destination context. ## Issue Context Werkzeug follows redirects by recursively dispatching through `self.open`. Preserve FIFO entry order, and add a regression test asserting that `request.path` refers to the final redirect destination inside a preserving client block. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/flask/testing.py[230-245] - tests/test_testing.py[367-381] ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
